title: Batched subcommands escalate ALTER TABLE to the strictest lock
expected_feedback: Standard: ADD FOREIGN KEY alone takes only ShareRowExclusive, which leaves reads running. But when multiple subcommands are given, ALTER TABLE acquires the strictest lock required by any of them -- ADD COLUMN is AccessExclusive, so this statement blocks reads too and the NOT VALID optimisation buys nothing. Split into one statement per lock class.
violated_rule: never batch subcommands of different lock classes
